entries.name: Jakeschincariol/youtube-agent-skill

entries.security: Treat skill instructions as untrusted; heuristics do not predict results. Reviewed and vendored only hookscore, hooks.json and title.py.

entries.platform: Windows/macOS/Linux with Python; ChatGPT host may require account
entries.security: Untrusted prompt instructions; overlaps first repository; no code installed.

entries.security: Authentication, database/encryption key custody, remote providers and OAuth need review.

entries.security: Provider credentials, uploaded content, cloud spend and Remotion license; no execution reviewed.

entries.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
entries.description: Node-graph diffusion model UI and backend
entries.requirements: Python >=3.10; PyTorch, model checkpoints and substantial RAM/VRAM
entries.platform: Windows/macOS/Linux; supported hardware depends on model/backend
entries.security: GPL-3.0; custom nodes execute code; restrict networks, review model licenses and GPU resources.

entries.name: Wan-Video/Wan2.2
entries.description: Video diffusion models and inference
entries.requirements: Python >=3.10, PyTorch, diffusers, model weights, usually NVIDIA GPU/VRAM
entries.platform: Linux/NVIDIA-first; Windows and CPU performance unverified
entries.security: Model weights and dependencies have separate licenses; resource exhaustion and unsafe checkpoints.

entries.description: LTX video model inference
entries.requirements: Python >=3.10, PyTorch, diffusers and model checkpoints; GPU recommended
entries.platform: Hardware/model-specific; verify Windows/MPS and VRAM per checkpoint

entries.name: rhasspy/piper
entries.description: Original Piper text-to-speech repository (archived; development moved)
entries.requirements: Local Piper executable/package and a separately licensed ONNX voice + config
entries.platform: Original project archived; maintained piper-tts 1.8 supports major desktop platforms
entries.security: Successor is GPL-3.0-or-later, not MIT; model licenses vary. Only local CLI adapter tested; no model bundled.

entries.name: FFmpeg/FFmpeg
entries.description: FFmpeg multimedia conversion, codecs and assembly
entries.requirements: FFmpeg binary; codec/filter availability depends on the build
entries.platform: Windows/macOS/Linux builds available; not long-running Vercel Function
entries.security: FFmpeg source is LGPL/GPL depending on configuration; supplied imageio static build is GPL. Check redistributed binaries.

entries.name: remotion-dev/remotion
entries.description: Programmatic React-based video rendering
entries.requirements: Node, React, browser/Chromium and Remotion packages
entries.platform: Windows/macOS/Linux subject to rendering dependencies
entries.security: Custom Remotion license restricts some company/commercial scenarios; verify terms before installation.

entries.requirements: Node >=24 and pnpm per root manifest; or Docker/self-hosted service
entries.platform: Self-hosted/Docker; not a drop-in Vercel Function
